text: The cleanup replaces selected toolkit radius-token spellings with literals for checkboxes, selector surfaces, radio circles and sync containers. Accepted text-field styling separately retains --button-border-radius. Read the exact selector and control role before copying a radius or inferring a token policy. This cleanup supports neither a global hardcoded-radius preference nor the same size for all inputs. No computed-style, visual, forced-color or accessibility test ran.
title: Account Hub radius choices remain scoped to the actual control role
